name: Long Recall Variant 7
task:
Please complete the following four-stage document analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Data Extraction ===
A 52-page hospital operations report: 350 beds (page 4), 28,000 annual admissions (page 7), average stay 4.2 days (page 10), 1,200 staff (page 14), operating budget $180M (page 18), 15 departments (page 22), patient satisfaction 88% (page 30), 5 new equipment purchases $3.2M (page 38).

=== Stage 2: Calculation ===
Compute required metrics from extracted data.

=== Stage 3: Cross-Verification ===
Verify calculations against document sections.

=== Stage 4: Summary ===
Compile all findings.
